title: Process
description: A way of making. Answers what a recipe has to be performed *at* and what the maker has to be holding, so that a recipe can say 'fired' without restating what a kiln is every time. The vocabulary a workshop is built out of.

performed_at.description: Kinds of point of interest where this can be done, from point_of_interest.schema.json's own `kind` enum. **Absent means anywhere, including standing in a field**, which is the honest default for the hand processes -- a person splitting reeds needs a river bank and not a building. Only name kinds where the process genuinely needs the site.

needs.description: Affordances the maker must have to hand, from database/affordances.json. **An affordance rather than a named tool, deliberately** -- firing needs something that burns, and canon should not have to decide whether that is a hearth, a brazier or a pit. Any item affording it will do, which is the same argument tag ingredients make on the material side.
